visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a young Asian man wearing a thick black hooded puffer jacket, looking upwards with a slightly surprised expression as snowflakes fall around his face. The background shows a modern building exterior with warm yellow recessed ceiling lights casting a soft glow. (2) Handheld wide shot panning across a wet asphalt parking lot at night during a heavy snowfall. Numerous parked cars, including white and dark-colored SUVs, are partially covered in white snow. A large retail building with BOOK-OFF and Hard Off signage is visible in the background under bright floodlights. (3) A handheld panning shot of a quiet suburban street at night. Snow accumulates on the dark asphalt road, leafless trees, and rooftops of residential houses. A white car with its headlights on drives slowly through the wet slush, creating reflections on the ground. (4) Interior shot of a bright, well-lit clothing store, identified as Uniqlo. Rows of puffer jackets and thermal leggings are neatly displayed on wooden shelves and mannequins dressed in layered winter gear. The environment is warm with clean lines and bright overhead studio-style lighting. (5) A shot from inside a car window looking out towards a Lawson convenience store at night. The window pane is rapidly accumulating thick, white clumps of wet snow, partially obscuring the view of the bright blue and white neon store sign across the parking lot. (6) A view of the front windshield of a car from the driver's interior perspective. Thick, dense clumps of snow are sticking to the exterior glass surface, quickly filling the entire pane from top to bottom, effectively blocking all visibility to the outside world. (7) A low-angle shot looking straight up into the night sky, with snowflakes falling directly toward the camera lens. The backdrop features bright street lights and the glowing Lawson signage of a convenience store building. The man's face briefly appears at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Location Context -> Direct Evidence of Weather -> Lifestyle Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a traveler's firsthand experience during a severe cold wave in Japan. It uses a mix of outdoor shots to showcase the intensity of the snowfall and interior retail shots to contrast the extreme temperature differences, all set to an emotional Japanese ballad to evoke a sense of atmosphere and winter beauty.
